name: Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Limited
about: Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of metallic yarns and textile fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers polyester lacquer / coated polyester films, transfer foils, and slitted M type yarns; MH type, MX type, and ST type yarns; LAC coated metallized polyester films; and glitter powders. It also engages in the film packaging and printing, and chemicals operations. The company exports its products. Its yarns are used for the made-ups in apparel, hosiery, and garment industries. The company was formerly known as Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Private Limited. Lakhotia Polyesters (India) Limited was founded in 1980 and is based in Malegaon, India.
